entities.name: Cult of Rimewind
entities.description: Esoteric order of wizards (cryomancers) in Terisiare who studied and worshiped the eternal ice; broken after Heidar's Phyrexian schemes.

entities.name: Rimewind Keep
entities.description: Keep in the Boreal where the cult dwelt.

entities.name: Gendrin
entities.description: Leader of the cult who ordered spells to halt the Thaw; murdered by Heidar.

entities.name: Heidar
entities.description: Gendrin's protege who discovered Phyrexian etchings, murdered his master, and reanimated Phyrexian war-beasts before being assassinated.

entities.name: Order of Stromgald
entities.description: Undead order allied with Heidar for protection from New Argive.

entities.name: Haakon
entities.description: Leader of the Order of Stromgald.

entities.name: New Argive
entities.description: Power that discovered Rimewind's plans and sought to end them by force.

entities.name: Krov
entities.description: Land ruled by a vampire queen, allied with Rimewind.

entities.name: Garza Zol
entities.description: Vampire queen of Krov who ordered assassins to kill Heidar.

entities.name: Lovisa Coldeyes
entities.description: Leader of a Balduvian force that stormed Rimewind.

entities.name: Kjeldor
entities.description: Nation that retaliated against the Phyrexian beasts and called on Yavimaya shamans.

entities.name: Yavimaya
entities.description: Forest whose shamans destroyed the Phyrexians and ended Rimewind's winter.

entities.name: Thaw
entities.description: The warming at the end of the Ice Age.

entities.name: Terisiare
entities.description: Continent of Dominaria where the cult operated.

events.summary: As the Thaw proceeds, Gendrin orders spells that temporarily halt it on Heidar's advice, plunging the continent back into winter.
events.quote: Gendrin , the leader of the cult, ordered the casting of spells that temporarily halted the Thaw

events.summary: Heidar finds Phyrexian etchings in the keep's depths and goes mad; he murders Gendrin and takes command.
events.quote: in a fit of pique, Heidar murdered his master and assumed command of Rimewind

events.summary: Heidar allies with the Order of Stromgald and Krov to locate relics and gain protection from New Argive.
events.quote: Heidar allied with the undead Order of Stromgald and their leader Haakon

events.summary: The cult reanimates Phyrexian war-beasts; when Lovisa Coldeyes' Balduvians storm Rimewind, Heidar activates them, causing a massacre and rampage.
events.quote: Heidar activated the Phyrexians , turning the battle into a massacre

events.summary: Garza Zol's assassins kill the mad Heidar.
events.quote: they managed to kill the mad wizard

events.summary: Yavimayan shamans destroy the Phyrexians; Kjeldor and Yavimaya rout the cultists and a ritual ends the unnatural winter, restoring the Thaw.
events.quote: a Yavimayan ritual permanently ended Rimewind's unnatural winter and restored the Thaw to its proper course
